subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep this broad field report open as a routing umbrella, split the remaining work into narrower canonical issues, or close it after linking the active config and message-loss trackers?
rationale: The issue mixes fixed bugs, documented behavior, open product-policy decisions, and operator suggestions across multiple owners; automation cannot decide whether the umbrella itself is still useful.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Move remaining unresolved slices to focused owner-scoped issues, keep links to the useful field evidence, then close this issue once every slice has a durable tracker.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad field-report tracker until maintainers finish or reject every referenced slice.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this issue now with links to the active narrower issues, accepting that weaker resource/update slices may need new reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Move remaining unresolved slices to focused owner-scoped issues, keep links to the useful field evidence, then close this issue once every slice has a durable tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled current-main evidence and broad ownership decision cut across gateway startup, config recovery, cron, onboarding, and channel behavior where their recent history is closest.
